//: Envelope for the oracle adjudication chain (chain-oracle-*.json), mounted by `config set default-oracle-chain` or --oracle. Two capabilities, both in-process: oracle.submit_verdict (the one model-facing verdict tool; delivery runs through the service layer under the SUBAGENT envelope's own attention bounds) and oracle.verdict_state (the deterministic chain gate). Everything else is denied — deny, not approve, because nobody watches this chain to answer an ask, and an ask it raised would be offered back to itself. No shell, no filesystem, no network: the oracle executes nothing and no command/prefix rule exists to be subverted via PATH.

rules.//: The verdict tool. A wait verdict executes nothing; an answer or approve/deny verdict is still bounded by the subagent envelope's attention.allowAgentAnswers / maxAgentAnswers and attention.allowAgentApprovals / maxAgentApprovals, enforced in the service layer.
The deterministic corrective gate — a pure in-process read of the bound contract's state; never advertised to the model.
